job.title: Shopware-Entwickler (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your role needs a developer who delivers shop features for clients independently – my daily work for 5+ years on large online shops at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Catalog, pricing, promotions and order features
– REST APIs and third-party / ERP integrations
– JavaScript, SQL and query performance tuning

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Online Shops, APIs, JavaScript & SQL | 5+ Years
tailoring.summary: E-commerce developer with 5+ years building and extending large online shops (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Implements shop functionality end to end: product catalog, pricing, promotions, checkout-related order flows and storefront customization with JavaScript and responsive design. Strong in REST APIs, third-party and ERP / PIM integrations, SQL and query performance tuning, Git and CI/CD deployment cycles. Works independently with business stakeholders, performs code reviews and uses AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: eBakery builds online shops for brands, which means varied projects and direct impact on how clients sell. I want to bring my experience from large commerce platforms to an agency team where I can deliver complete shop features and work close to the client. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Shopware Developer role caught my eye: 5+ years building large online shops (catalog, promotions, integrations, JS, SQL) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Shopware Developer
en.hook: An agency like eBakery needs developers who can deliver shop features for clients reliably and independently. That is what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and extend large online shops – from catalog and promotions to integrations and storefront – in close contact with business teams.

bullets.label: Online shop development
bullets.text: Implemented functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data and developed Promotions Engine and Order Management features.

bullets.label: Integrations & APIs
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs for headless and PWA frontends and integrated third-party services; built PIM data pipelines.

bullets.label: Frontend & databases
bullets.text: Worked with JavaScript and storefront customization and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency.

bullets.label: Client focus
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, supported production issues and performed code reviews.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss in a conversation how I can strengthen your shop projects.
